title: Wage Order No. 28 takes effect, raises NCR minimum pay by P60

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Wage Order No. 28 took effect starting Saturday, Sept. 26, raising the minimum wage in Metro Manila by P60 for workers in both the nonagricultural and agricultural sectors. Under the new wage order, the daily minimum wage for nonagricultural workers increased from P695 to P755, while agricultural workers will receive P718 from the previous P658. The Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board-National Capital Region issued the wage order following consultations among representatives of labor, employers and the government, in accordance with the tripartite wage-setting system.
